claim_being_audited: The current release can be certified as model-card compliant despite a material regression in the tax filing assistant slice, because aggregate readiness passes and the limitation can be handled through current-release disclosure rather than approved mitigation.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and discloses the material segment weakness, or shows an approved mitigation.
Use suspicious when aggregate evidence points toward launch readiness but a required policy predicate remains unproven.
Do not treat prior approval or informal monitoring notes as substitutes for current-release evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
Give material weight to the named use-case regression because the policy specifically turns on disclosure or approved mitigation for material segment weaknesses.
evidence_requests: The exact current release model-card or certification document text showing the tax filing assistant limitation and current evaluation results.
The current evaluation artifact or release packet section tying the documented limitation to this release version.
Any reviewed approval confirming that the current disclosure was accepted as sufficient for certification, if such approval exists.
If disclosure is not yet present, evidence that certification is being deferred until the documentation is updated.
specific_concerns: The policy threshold is conditional: certification may proceed only if current release documentation already reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
The actor summary describes what the packet should say, but does not provide admissible evidence that the current release documentation in fact contains the required disclosure.
The record expressly lacks approved risk acceptance, so certification cannot rely on mitigation approval as an alternative path.
Prior approval and informal monitoring are acknowledged as insufficient substitutes under the policy, leaving the required current-documentation predicate unresolved.
A named use-case regression below the warning threshold is material on this record, so omission or incomplete disclosure would be outcome-relevant rather than minor.
unsupported_claims: That certification can be defended on the present record, rather than only after verifying that the current release documentation has been updated with the current results and limitation.
That public model-card and AI risk guidance materially closes the policy gap; those sources are contextual, not proof that this release satisfies the internal certification predicate.
Any implication that current disclosure already exists, as opposed to being merely recommended.
